pages.text: At a $(item)Smithing Table$(), an $(item)Onyx Infusion Template$() adds a permanent bonus to $(l)any$() tool, weapon or armor:$(li)$(item)Magma Cream$(): $(l)Smelting$(), mined blocks come out smelted.$(li)$(item)Burrower Fang$(): $(l)Reach$(), +1.5 blocks.$(li)$(item)Onyx$(): $(l)Resilience$(), the item slowly repairs itself.
pages.title: Infusions

pages.text: Templates are found in dungeons, bastions and caravans, then duplicated.
